description.p: KyprX gives KDE Plasma 6 on Wayland the look of a tiling window manager: windows side by side, with no title bars, an outline, a see-through background and blur behind them.

It tiles the windows itself, from inside KWin: a layout for each number of windows, drawn in percentages or picked from the ones it comes with, filled automatically or zone by zone as you drop windows into it, with rules for the windows that float.

It gathers in one window what four other programs keep in separate settings: Klassy for the window decoration, Better Blur DX for the blur, Geometry Change for the animation of windows moving, and Smart Video Wallpaper Reborn for video wallpapers. On top of them it adds colour presets for the whole desktop, profiles, a wallpaper picker and a cheatsheet of the keyboard shortcuts.
